title: Hruday new observables and dimensions in SU(2): the two-plaquette graph, the 1x2 loop, the electric band and 2+1D
accepted: On the Round11 two-plaquette graph H_FG(l1,l2) = K - l1 W_1 - l2 W_2 (open two-square patch, 6 vertices, 7 links, gauge-invariant sector, K the sum of the seven link Casimirs at rho=1, alpha units, trace-monomial cutoffs D=6 and D=8), the coefficients through total order 4 are identical at both cutoffs: <W_1> = l1/6 - 5 l1^3/864 + l1 l2^2/4212, <z> = 7 l1 l2/216 - 349 (l1^3 l2 + l1 l2^3)/303264 for the 1x2 loop z, and <C_shared> = (l1^2 + l2^2)/48 - 5 (l1^4 + l2^4)/4608 - 49 l1^2 l2^2/438048; <W_1> is odd in l1 and even in l2 by the one-link flips of h1 and h2, <z> is odd in each coupling and <C_shared> even in each; at l1=l2=l with |l| in {1/10, 1/100, 1/1000} and both signs the certified enclosures of <z> are positive at D=6 and D=8, with D=8 relative width at most 1.79645e-17 against the frozen 1/10^16. In the zero-selected SU(2) family (AM2/AQ1, |tau| at most 10^-8, cover R={0,e_z}) the 1x2 Wilson loop W_{1x2} of the omitted xz faces at 0 and e_x has first-order coefficient 0 in every box, satisfies |omega(W_{1x2})| <= K_2' tau^2 (K_2' the AY1 gate constant; about 1.34175e-12 at |tau|=10^-8) for every F1 and F2 box and for the limit of the named constructions at both signs, is even in tau in every F1 box and for the limit, and has the formal second-order coefficient 7/124416 (labelled formal_second_order_coefficient: no sign and no certified remainder); the electric energy omega(h_R) on R lies in [(3/2)L^2, 98|tau|], about [2.87586637818e-19, 9.8e-7] at |tau|=10^-8, with L the AY2 lower distance, for every F1 and F2 box (untruncated at fixed N) and for the limit, at both signs. In the declared 2+1-dimensional model the AM2 counting gives p=3, J=|tau|, termination order 6, G_3(R)=9 e^{3/32} and G_3'(R)=118 e^{3/32} at R=1/64, and the cap |tau| <= 1/(576 e^{3/32}) (directed lower bound 1580747155173/10^15), with no finite-volume theorem. On the Round11 two-plaquette graph with independent couplings, the exact low-order coefficients of the face mean, the 1x2 loop and the shared-link Casimir are computed with zero truncation error, the face mean is odd in its own coupling and even in the other, and the 1x2 loop has a certified sign at every grid point; in the zero-selected SU(2) family the 1x2 Wilson mean vanishes at first order and is even in tau, with only a formal second-order coefficient, the electric energy on the cover lies in a certified two-sided band for every box and for the limit of the named constructions, and the 2+1-dimensional AM2 constants are recounted; these are statements about named models and a finite graph, not an area law, not a certified sign of the 1x2 mean, not uniqueness of any ground state, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a.
limitations: Graph scope: the Round11 two-square patch only, at D=6 and D=8 and the declared grid; static means with no dynamical or mass-gap reading; transfers_to_aq false; the graph coefficients are finite-graph values, and 7/124416 = (7/216)/24^2 is a labelled identity between the graph and the formal Z^3 coefficient, not a transfer.

Z^3 scope: the zero-selected family at |tau| at most 10^-8, the fixed cover R and fixed spacing; no certified value or sign of the Z^3 1x2 mean (the admitted bound K_2' tau^2 exceeds the formal term by about 2.38479e8; a certified sign needs a uniform fourth-order remainder, and for F2 boxes a third-order one); evenness in tau is not claimed for F2 boxes.

The band is two-sided but loose (ratio about 3.4e12) and is not a tight enclosure, which would need a second-order upper bound for the unbounded h_R; its lower end rests on the AY1 forward F11-F14 per-box ball (a reviewed step, not a gate sentence) for boxes and on AY2 item (2) for the limit; its upper end passes to the limit by lower semicontinuity only.
No area law and no string-tension statement is made: no zero-free region of the reduced density is admitted.
2+1 dimensions: recounted AM2 constants only; no finite-volume ground-state or gap theorem and no AQ chain, node or dictionary in 2+1 dimensions (g^2 has mass dimension); each needs its own contract.

The enclosures use the admitted AZ2 certificate code copied verbatim (Weyl gap 3-2|l|, Temple, the Round11 Schur-complement tail comparison, Eckart and Davis-Kahan angles); the skeptic re-evaluated the lemma in its own basis and has its own sharper tail certificate (worst D=8 relative width 3.56e-18); Kato, Weyl, Temple, Eckart, Davis-Kahan, Peter-Weyl and Fuchs-van de Graaf are cited, not machine-checked.

Review standing: model-agent skeptic with correlated ancestry (same model family as the producer and the advisor); its pre-comparison package was committed after the producer packet, with its values final before the producer commit; not human peer review; scientific priority is not verified; weak coupling and the continuum are not addressed, and no estimate is made uniformly in the lattice spacing a.
model: (a) the finite-graph model H_FG(l1,l2) = K - l1 W_1 - l2 W_2 on the Round11 two-plaquette graph (open two-square patch, 6 vertices, 7 links, gauge-invariant sector, K the sum of the seven link Casimirs at rho=1, alpha units, trace-monomial cutoffs D in {6,8}); (b) the SU(2) zero-selected patterned family (AM2/AQ1, |tau|<=10^-8) with the frozen 1x2 rectangle W_{1x2} and the electric energy h_R on the cover R={0,e_z}, in every finite box of F1 and F2 (untruncated at fixed N) and the limit of the named constructions (BB2); (c) the AM2 creation expansion re-instantiated in 2+1 dimensions for the declared model and factorization (radius 1/64, AM2 normalization)
decision: Admit the applications of the admitted SU(2) equations to new observables and a new dimension, single direction with the skeptic's independent replay. (1) On the two-plaquette graph with independent couplings the Rayleigh-Schroedinger coefficients through total order 4 are exact and identical at D=6 and D=8 (zero truncation error): <W_1> = l1/6 - 5 l1^3/864 + l1 l2^2/4212, <z> = 7 l1 l2/216 - 349 (l1^3 l2 + l1 l2^3)/303264 for the 1x2 loop z, <C_shared> = (l1^2+l2^2)/48 - 5 (l1^4+l2^4)/4608 - 49 l1^2 l2^2/438048; <W_1> is odd in l1 and even in l2 by the one-link flips of faces 1 and 2; at l1=l2 the second-order values are 7/216 for <z> and 1/24 for <C_shared>, and the diagonal reproduces the admitted AZ2 series. (2) Certified enclosures of <z> at l1=l2 in {+-1/1000, +-1/100, +-1/10} at D=6 and D=8 are positive (sign certified), nested, and at D=8 have relative width at most about 1.79645e-17 against the frozen 1/10^16 (margin about 5.57; the skeptic's sharper certificate gives 3.56e-18), with the AZ2-type itemized residual (Eckart, Schur complement and Davis-Kahan angle lemma). (3) For the frozen Z^3 1x2 rectangle the first-order coefficient of omega(W_{1x2}) is exactly 0 and |omega(W_{1x2})| <= K_2' tau^2 (about 1.34175e-12 at the cap) for every F1 and F2 box and the limit of the named constructions; evenness in tau holds for F1 boxes and the limit (AW1 flip, area 2, and BB2 at each sign) and is not claimed for F2 boxes; 7/124416 is a labelled formal second-order coefficient, with no sign or certified value. (4) The electric energy on R lies in [(3/2)L^2, 98|tau|] at both signs for every finite box of F1 and F2 and the limit, with L the AY2 two-sided first-order distance, about [2.8759e-19, 49/50000000] at tau=+-10^-8 (lower by Fuchs-van de Graaf for the pure reference and the on-site gap, upper by the admitted energy budget and lower semicontinuity through the cutoff); the formal second-order value 7 tau^2/144 is labelled, and a tight enclosure is a recorded obstruction (the band is about 3.4e12 wide). (5) In 2+1 dimensions the AM2 recount gives maximal support 3, per-site sum |tau|, termination order 6, G_3(1/64) = 9 e^{3/32} and G_3'(1/64) = 118 e^{3/32} with a directed enclosure of e^{3/32}, and the admissible cap |tau| at most about 1.5807e-3 (the self-map binds); no finite-volume 2+1D theorem, node or dictionary is claimed. Obligations and no-transfer rows: an area law (no zero-free region), a certified sign of the Z^3 1x2 mean (a uniform higher-order remainder), a tight electric enclosure, the site-blocked uniform 3+1D regime, the AQ chain in 2+1 dimensions, and the Einstein-QED rounds (no shared equation). Recorded non-blocking: the producer's contract readings W1-W7 (the model id names only the graph; evenness admitted only for F1 and the limit; the 2+1D 'stars' reading; negative couplings outside the Round11 solver's API); two exported fields not validated by the producer itself; the AZ2 algebra copied verbatim with attribution and the Round11 solver bound by text only; three silent edits caught only by the skeptic's validator; commit order forward 37fa623 before the skeptic package bf1f531 with the skeptic's values final earlier. These are statements about named models and a finite graph, not an area law, not a certified sign of the 1x2 mean, not uniqueness of any ground state and not uniform in the lattice spacing a. Applications stage complete; all eight Round33 investigations gated.
